title: fix: plugin-ai i18n wiring and Studio times in the display locale (objectui#10232)
body:
Fixes #10232
Clause-②: no

Both display-locale faces on objectui#10232, in one PR. Implemented by `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb` (seat `domain:ui#3`), based on `8b1f06619`.

## What changed

### Item 2: Studio faces no longer use `useMetadataLocale()` as an `Intl` locale
- `StudioHomePage`: the "recently viewed" `relativeTime` now gets `useDisplayLocale()`. It used to get `useMetadataLocale()`.
- `StudioDesignSurface` (`DataPillar`): the last-saved time (`savedAt.toLocaleTimeString`) also uses `useDisplayLocale()`. The sentence around it still comes from the designer's string table.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the `useMetadataLocale` docblock now says it must never be used as an `Intl` locale, because it is `'en-US'` for every language except zh. It is kept for the two-language `t()` / `tFormat()` tables.
- Premise re-derived on `8b1f06619`. The hook is still `/^zh/i.test(language) ? 'zh-CN' : 'en-US'`. I checked every file that calls `useMetadataLocale()` for `Intl.*` / `toLocale*` / `*Format(… locale …)` uses, and these two faces are the only ones. The other `Intl` sites in those files (`ResourceHistoryPage`, `JobPreview`, `ExternalDatasourcePanel`, `DatasetPreview`) already use the display locale since objectui#9909.

### Item 1: `@object-ui/plugin-ai` wired to `@object-ui/i18n` as a whole
- `packages/plugin-ai/package.json` adds `@object-ui/i18n` (dependency) and `@object-ui/test-support` (devDependency). `pnpm-lock.yaml` was regenerated by `pnpm install` (6 added lines in the plugin-ai importer), not edited by hand.
- New `src/useAiTranslation.ts` follows the plugin-chatbot `useAiApprovalsTranslation.ts` shape. It holds a `createSafeTranslation` defaults map that mirrors the `en` pack, plus `formatPercent(score, locale)`.
- Strings: 17 keys in a new `ai.*` namespace (`ai.nlQuery.*` 7, `ai.formAssist.*` 7, `ai.recommendations.*` 3), translated in all ten packs. Counts use the repo's two-key plural convention (`*One` is picked at the call site when the count is exactly one, as with `search.itemsAvailableOne`).
- Display locale: the `nl-query` history date is now `toLocaleDateString(displayLocale)`. It was a bare `toLocaleDateString()`, which uses the machine's locale. The confidence and score percentages go through `Intl.NumberFormat(displayLocale, percent)` instead of a `Math.round(...)` followed by a literal percent sign.
- README: new "Localization" section. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-ai.mdx` points readers to the README.

### Census coverage (hypothesis 4)
The objectui#9909 census is `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`. It builds its population from every workspace manifest that names `@object-ui/i18n`, so after this change it covers `packages/plugin-ai` with no edit to the census file. With the fix, the history-date expression passes the census. With the ablation below (the bare call put back), the census goes red on its `no call site passes nothing, undefined or the default pseudo-tag unless it is declared` case.

### One PR, not two
Triage allowed a split. I kept one PR because both items are small, their file sets don't overlap, and the claim names this one branch. A second PR would need a second branch that no claim names, plus a second write.

## Tests (source tree at `5bab5d4d7`; `e957b05fc` adds only the README section)
- New `packages/plugin-ai/src/aiComponents.i18n-10232.test.tsx`: history date de-DE `4.3.2020` vs en `3/4/2020`; the two sessions differ; runtime tripwire; de strings; the singular key at one; de-DE percent; English with no provider; the defaults map mirrors the `en` pack in both directions.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/StudioHomePage.displayLocale-10232.test.tsx`: `vor 3 Tagen` vs `3 days ago` with the UI language `en` in both sessions, plus the tripwire.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.savedAtDisplayLocale-10232.test.tsx`: a real auto-save lands, de-DE shows a 24-hour time, en shows AM/PM, plus the tripwire.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-ai/ packages/i18n/src/__tests__/`: 73 files, 1182 tests passed (includes the census and all-locales key parity).
- `vitest run` DataPillar* + studio-locale + metadataAdminFaces-9909 + StudioHomePage-10232 + the two AppContent route suites: 12 files, 97 tests passed. `StudioDesignSurface*`: 23 files, 118 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-ai run type-check` and `build` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exits 0 after building its dependency closure.
- Ablation (committed first, trap restore, then `git diff HEAD` checked empty): three edits confirmed on disk by `grep -c` (mutant 1 1 1, fix 0 0 0). Result: 9 failed, 15 passed across the 4 files, including the census case above. Tree restored.

## Gates (exit codes captured to files before reading)
`check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:i18n-drift` 0 (17 keys added, 0 en values changed) · `check:i18n-dead-keys` 0 (no `ai.*` key listed) · `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0 · `check:phantom-deps` 0 · `check:unused-deps` 0 · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 · `check:published-tsconfig-exclude` 0 · `check:lockfile-integrity` 0 · `check:lockfile-dedupe` 0 · `check:vi-mock-*` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `check:changeset-claims` 0 · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `check:esm-specifiers` 0 · `check:governed-queue-guard` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check:self-import` 0 · changeset presence 0 · no-major 0 · eslint on the 20 touched ts/tsx files: 0 errors (20 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs a built `apps/console/dist`). `check:dist-completeness`, reason: `packages/app-shell/dist` was not built locally (only its dependency closure was). Full app-shell and console suites and a repo-wide lint are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes
- The plugin-ai icon-only buttons (refresh, dismiss, apply, reject) have no accessible names. That is outside this card, and no carrier was identified.
- The `ComponentRegistry` labels in `plugin-ai/src/index.tsx` are English designer metadata, like every other plugin's registration labels. They are not translated here.
- `ai-recommendations` offers `layout: 'carousel'` (in the schema type and the registration enum), but the renderer shows it as a list. Reported to the seat, not changed here.
- Draft PR objectui#8941 also edits `packages/plugin-ai/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Whichever lands second regenerates the lockfile.
